_comment: FleetLink node roster (CEO order 2026-10-04; law: O-20260928-1855(3) state-plane v2, server-governance v2). Enabled nodes get poked by fleet-dispatch. Poke carries signals only - git stays the sole data channel. Adoption per machine: 1) tailscale up -> send login URL to CEO for one click (bm-b/bm-c); 2) fill host/tailnet_ip/root/repos/wake_tasks/status_files here; 3) set enabled=true; 4) run: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File Tools\register-fleet-link.ps1 (idempotent, silent, no elevation needed - Tailscale-In firewall rules cover inbound). SYNC TIERS (CEO order O-20261009-1755, T1 delegated): HOT = 'poke_repos' - the poke worker pulls ONLY these on every poke (command plane: orders/decisions/laws/tools - seconds-fresh, small). WARM = every other repo in 'repos' - pulled by its OWN loop task on round cadence (woken via wake_tasks); poke worker does NOT duplicate. COLD = no auto-pull, on-demand only. Force-pull on demand: Tools\fleet-dispatch.ps1 -Repos 'gaming/MiniGame' (allowlisted against node.repos).
